title: Demonstrate deterministic rounding residue in a P104 native collector
body:
PR2586 restores its private collectors exactly, but a rounded child still needs a valid zero-only erase boundary. This contribution gives a deterministic counterexample for its first physical collector: with nearest-even grid `h=2^-b`, every `b>=4` admits the grid input `D31=(1+h)delta_0` and leaves `C=-h delta_0` at event 2039. The outbound rank-seven child has defect norm `h <= u(1+h)` at `u=h`; the return child is exact. Thus the local relative-error test can pass while strict-zero erasure fails.

The new package independently executes the two pinned physical native recipes and all fifteen collector instructions. All 512 exact round-trip columns match; a separate tensor formula checks the outbound columns. Exact arithmetic and four additional output bits repair this particular input. This is a local interface result, not an exclusion of mixed precision, reversible cleanup, residual-tolerant disposal, or all rounded implementations. It does not execute a uniformly rounded full caller or claim a supplier/new kappa.

**Sources and scope:** current canonical main `b4560d9e7216f72b73c5aa940ac099c05e33ccf9`, priority revision 5; `p104-side-correction`, refined to deterministic native collector quantization. PR2586 is frozen at `7953c9a8f788a8de5cf2ced63d9a61b67c22c6f1`; its word and native archive are retained byte-for-byte. This takes PR2549's concrete rounded-child handoff (`bd3bea4b4e09ead04355a477a7c28559427d1ef6`) rather than repeating its abstract-defect/norm audit. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2245#discussioncomment-18953699). The task card contains exact pins, overlap coverage, family stop decision and open next questions. No predecessor or selected record changes.

**Validation on CPython 3.12.14, macOS arm64:**

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-rounded-collector
python3.12 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'
git diff --check
```

Registered replay, all six behavioral control groups, metadata/source pins and 65 workflow tests passed (three skips). Controls cover strict-zero rounded rejection, exact/finer-grid success, wrong cleanup sign, native global phase, quantizer ties/equivariance, source/receipt mutation and Git-free export. Direct optimized replay also passed on CPython 3.14.7. No full selected cold replay, physical cleanup/owner/precision/tape admission, all-size theorem, formal proof or independent human review is claimed. Hosted CI is separate.

Credit ywz65/PR2586/2497 for the exact word/native realization; Nick Petalas/PR2549/2550 for the precision handoff and complementary-chart idea; PR2551 for the physical boundary distinction; Adam Gall/PR2096 for the Hilbert-defect precedent; and the full P104/native lineage retained in the package README. Prepared for Arham Tahir with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematics, code, checking and writing. No subagents. Apache-2.0.
